design.rule: deterministic four-entry binary lookup table per task
design.evaluation: four evaluation queries per task; calibration costs four extra queries
design.fast_only: known rules cached; unseen tasks use all-zero fallback
design.hybrid: uses cache when available; otherwise calibrates, verifies and caches

interpretation: Hybrid matched exploratory accuracy and used 33.3% fewer counted queries. The toy is deliberately easy after calibration and does not establish general reasoning or consciousness.
